what: RB Global runs marketplaces for used commercial assets. Ritchie Bros auctions heavy construction equipment and trucks, and IAA auctions damaged and salvage vehicles for insurers.
customers: Construction and transport companies buying and selling used equipment, and insurance companies disposing of written-off vehicles.
money: equipment and truck auctions and marketplace fees
moat: Auction yards, buyer networks and transaction data built over sixty years, which produce the price discovery that makes sellers choose it.
risks: Debt of about $4.7 billion from the IAA acquisition
Used equipment prices fell from pandemic highs, reducing fee revenue
IAA integration has taken longer than expected
Return on invested capital of about 6% reflects acquisition goodwill
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year and about 38% a year over three years including the acquisition
Analysts see about 38% upside from current levels
Combining construction and salvage auctions spreads fixed yard and technology costs
watch: Gross transaction value and service revenue take rate.
